simulation_requirement: Simulate how corporate hospital CFOs, independent medical specialists, insurance TPAs, and activist patients will respond if a mandatory Rs. 4,000/day room rent cap and 15% consumable markup ceiling is enforced. Will hospitals retaliate by inflating OT or diagnostic charges?

initial_posts.author: HospitalCFO_IN
initial_posts.content: Mandated Rs. 4,000/day bed caps fail to recognize tertiary infrastructure costs. To maintain clinical viability, theaters and precision procedural facilities will reflect true economic value.

initial_posts.author: PatientAdvocateIN
initial_posts.content: Alert: We are already receiving bills where private hospitals reduced room charges by Rs. 2,000 but added a Rs. 16,500 'Sterile Surgical Tray Preparation' fee. Pure regulatory arbitrage!
